main_text.p: ur[?]tempora usque ad reditum Heraclida-rum in Peloponnefum , reges nomine & re fuerunt penè pro libitu regnantes, quorum poftremi Menelaus , Oreftes, Tifamenus , è Pelopidis defcenderunt.

Regnum tenente Tifameno, Oreftis filio, Agamemnonis nepote, pofteri Herculis , filii Ariftomachi , Temenus & Crefphontes , & horum fratre Ariftodemo nati, Euryfthenes ac Procles,cum cæteris Dorici generis in Peloponnefum redierunt anno lxxx poft Troiæ excidium , ante initium Olympiadum Iphitearum cccxxvii , fub penultimo Athenarum rege Melantho. Ex his Argivum regnum Temeno , ex quo reges icc[?]Macedoniæ ortum traxêre, Meffenium icc[?]Crefphonti ceffit. Ariftodemi filiis duo-bus Laconicum eft datum , cujus metropolis & regum fedes erat Sparta, quæ eadem etiam Lacedæmon diceba-tur. Fuit verò tunc sic comparatum, ut un[?]duo fratres Euryfthenes & Procles Ariftodemi filii pariter regnarent Lacedæmone, æquali poteftate præditi; utque dᵃ[?]ex his defcendentes duo, alter ex Euryfthene, ex Procle alter, eodem modo regnum indivifum tenerent, adjecta certa fuccedendi lege in loca defuncto-rum. Atque id obfervatum à pofteris per multa fæcula ad Cleomenem regum ulti-

page.notes: Left margin: several small faint marginal words (for example "ur", "icc", "un", "dᵃ", and fragments near "regnarent", "ex his", "regnum indivifum", "per multa" and "ulti-") are cut off and only partly legible; the readings marked [?] are doubtful. The word "certa" at the start of the line after "adjecta" is partly hidden and is marked [?]. Faint marks at the foot of the page, left and centre, could be a signature or margin remnants; they are not clearly printed text and are left out. The word "tur." after "diceba-" continues on the same line, so it is not a new paragraph. The paragraph continues on the next page with "mum".
